description: Registre 2015 des installations de production raccordées au réseau de transport d'électricité is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce registre présente les installations de production raccordées au réseau de transport d'électricité au 31 décembre 2015. Vous y trouverez les puissances installées et les énergies annuelles produites. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Production, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are Parc. The portal shows 2018-05-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
